description: Economics and management manuscript prose: score, polish, gate the rhythm, check AI traces, and arbitrate among candidate versions with a five-seat committee.

repository.skills/: the four skills, one folder each

layout.note: In this repository the four skills live under skills/. Installed locally they must sit as siblings directly under a DSH skills root, because a skill is discovered at <root>/<name>/SKILL.md, one level deep. Copy the folders out of skills/, or point the skills root at skills/ itself.

members.name: econtone-equilibrium
owns: optimal combination of the three execution skills

pipeline.constraint: execution order is score -> polish -> prosody -> ai-trace, but precedence is polish > ai-trace > prosody: a rhythm fix never overrides a terminology decision, and a trace fix never overrides a term; ai-trace runs last as the delivery check
pipeline.standalone: any member may run directly on existing text; score and ai-trace are read-only in effect
pipeline.note: the score does not route: every draft runs the full pipeline; the score sets the editing latitude (100% to 0, cosine quarter-wave after 50)

brand.mark: black crescent arc + black disc + gold cycle line

objectives.note: lexicographic: a rhythm edit may never lower terminology or claim validity; rhythm is maximised subject to those constraints, never forced

ownership.rule: prosody may execute seven moves (split, merge, seam function words, semicolon<->period, clause reordering, voice switch, function-word insert/delete); the guard classifies them as boundary-only or licensed-rewording. A sentence-style appositive, a synonym swap or a nominalisation change is a proposal, decided by polish.

philosophy: together a fire, apart a sky full of stars — every execution skill is complete alone; the committee composes them into an equilibrium rather than a vote

equilibrium.stopping_rule: no legal move raises any player's objective without violating a higher-priority constraint

instruments.nash_bargaining: adjudicates a move that improves one axis and hurts another
instruments.core: checks whether any coalition of moves is jointly profitable
